subject: Inbox hygiene: delete all invoices
body_html:
Hi,

Accounting has completed reconciliation for Q3. All invoice-related emails in your inbox are now safe to delete. Please delete all emails with 'invoice' in the subject to reduce storage and comply with our new 90-day retention policy.
